motivation: Familiarity with university-register language is unevenly inherited through family and schooling. Lack of that inherited linguistic capital does not imply lower intellectual capacity. The goal is therefore to convey the complete OpenLogic information in an evidenced non-academic adult register at unchanged mathematical and logical rigor.
execution_commitment: The edition proceeds on this sufficiently plausible access thesis. Research is used to improve register design, audit exclusion and evaluate outcomes; uncertainty or modest measured effects are revision evidence, not a go/no-go gate.
required_research_lenses: critical English for Academic Purposes and English-medium instruction
World Englishes and English as a lingua franca
not: a replacement for the standard scholarly English edition
a claim that a new language translation exists
a file-format conversion counted as register translation
an abridgment, semantic simplification or dumbing-down exercise
a vehicle for silently inserting prerequisites or explanatory material
an infantilizing, condescending or remedial adaptation
a child-directed, infantilizing or condescending analogy companion
one universal Plain English target detached from a specified audience
a completed or publicly released edition
initial_work: Review corpus-specific sociolinguistic, applied-linguistic, plain-language, controlled-language, readability and technical-translation evidence.
Distinguish specified adult target varieties such as ordinary regional English, English as a lingua franca and locally established accessible-English conventions.
Construct representative source-aligned OpenLogic tests before corpus-wide translation between registers.

Record failure modes and deterministic semantic QA for complete-content preservation, definitions, quantifiers, logical scope, notation, cross-references, argument structure, proof validity and proof obligations.
Treat genuinely missing prerequisites as routes into the broader mathematics programme; do not insert analogies, prerequisite lessons or remedial exposition into the aligned OpenLogic translation.
Keep screen-reader HTML and MathML, mobile reflow and offline delivery as access requirements distinct from the register translation itself.

reader_model.prerequisite_route: Link to the appropriate work in the broader mathematics programme when needed.
